content:
Like me, if you've ever lost hours falling down the rabbit hole of Wikipedia's random articles, the official app now finally offers a way to do the same—technically, via a widget.

Now there's finally a button that can take you straight to a random Wikipedia article.

Today's update to the Wikipedia iOS app adds a fun and useful new feature: a 'random article' widget that can be placed on the home screen of your iPhone or iPad.

The widget comes in large and medium sizes, complete with a cute mascot to keep you company.

Tap the widget and it will take you directly to a completely random Wikipedia article, with 'random mode' turned on by default.

Without leaving the app, just keep hitting the 'random article' button and it'll keep rolling the dice, taking you deeper and deeper as you explore the maze of random articles.

Have fun, but watch the time slip away! Earlier this summer, the Wikipedia app already added a history quiz mini-game.

This brand-new widget is now live in today's updated Wikipedia app for iPhone and iPad.

Get even more out of your Apple devices
